lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Welcome to Green Hill Activity Centre.
lines.spa: Bienvenido/a al Centro de Actividades Green Hill.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Thank you. Where are the bedrooms?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: They're upstairs, next to the bathrooms.
lines.spa: Están arriba, al lado de los baños.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Is there a wi-fi code?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Yes, there is. It's on the noticeboard.
lines.spa: Sí. Está en el tablón de anuncios.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Great, thanks!

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Are there any computers here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Yes, there are. They're in the computer room.
lines.spa: Sí. Están en la sala de computación.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Where's the games room?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: It's downstairs, opposite the dining room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Are there any games consoles?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Yes, there are two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Welcome to my new house!

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Wow! Is there a garden?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Yes, there is. It's behind the house.
lines.spa: Sí. Está detrás de la casa.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Are there any bedrooms upstairs?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Yes, there are three bedrooms.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: What's your favourite room?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: The living room. It's very comfortable.
lines.spa: La sala de estar. Es muy cómoda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: We need a cake for the party.
lines.spa: Necesitamos una torta para la fiesta.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Is there a chocolate cake in the shop?
lines.spa: ¿Hay una torta de chocolate en la tienda?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Yes, there is.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Are there any balloons?

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: No, there aren't, but there are some posters.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: That's fine. Let's get the cake!

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: What's in your bedroom?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: There's a bed, a desk and a wardrobe.
lines.spa: Hay una cama, un escritorio y un ropero.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Is there a bookcase?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Yes. It's next to the desk.
lines.spa: Sí. Está al lado del escritorio.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Where's your lamp?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: It's on the desk, under the window.
lines.spa: Está sobre el escritorio, debajo de la ventana.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: What's your holiday home like?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: It's a small caravan near a lake.
lines.spa: Es una casa rodante pequeña cerca de un lago.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: How many bedrooms are there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: There are two small bedrooms.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Is there a shower?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Yes, there is, but there isn't a bath.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: What appliance do you use every day?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: I use my laptop every day.
lines.spa: Uso mi computadora portátil todos los días.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: How many hours do you use it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: About three hours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Do you monitor its energy use?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Yes. I want to save energy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Hi, I'm Mia. I'm a new student.
lines.spa: Hola, soy Mia. Soy una estudiante nueva.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Hi, Mia. This is our classroom.
lines.spa: Hola, Mia. Esta es nuestra aula.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Is this the computer room?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: No, it isn't. The computer room is next door.
lines.spa: No. La sala de computación está al lado.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Where are the toilets?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: They're at the end of the hall.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: What time is it in London?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: It's midday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: What time is it in Sydney?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: It's late in the evening there.
lines.spa: Allí es tarde por la noche.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Why is the time different?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Because the cities are in different time zones.
lines.spa: Porque las ciudades están en zonas horarias diferentes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Tell me about your ideal room.

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: There's a big window and a comfortable sofa.
lines.spa: Hay una ventana grande y un sofá cómodo.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Is there a desk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Yes. It's next to the window.
lines.spa: Sí. Está al lado de la ventana.

lines.speaker: A
lines.eng: Why is the room special?

lines.speaker: B
lines.eng: Because it's bright, quiet and relaxing.
lines.spa: Porque es luminosa, tranquila y relajante.

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Nora lives in a large house near a forest. There is a garden in front of the house and there are two fruit trees near the gate. Inside, there is a kitchen, a living room, a bathroom and three bedrooms. Nora's favourite room is the living room because it has a big sofa and two comfortable armchairs. Her bedroom is upstairs. There are some stars above her bed and a small desk next to the window.

Ben and Lily are preparing a birthday party for their friend. In the first shop, there are some cards and posters, but there aren't any balloons. There is a chocolate cake, but it is very small. In the second shop, there are balloons, presents and a large cake. They buy the large cake and some balloons, then go to the party.

questions.q: Are there any balloons in the first shop?
Is there a chocolate cake in the first shop?

questions.a: A large cake and some balloons
options: A large cake and some balloons

questions.q: Where do they go after shopping?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: In some British cities, people use unusual spaces as homes. One small flat is made from a recycled shipping container. Another modern home is inside a building that once had a completely different public function. Some companies also change old offices into small flats. These homes can be compact, modern and cheaper than traditional houses, and they can give unused buildings a new purpose.

questions.q: What can a shipping container become?
Are all the homes traditional houses?
What can happen to old offices?
Why can these homes be useful?
questions.a: They give old spaces a new purpose
options: They give old spaces a new purpose
They use more rooms than castles

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: A famous musician grew up in a semi-detached house in Liverpool. Downstairs, there was a living room and a kitchen. The kitchen was simple, with a sink and a cooker. Upstairs, there were two bedrooms. One bedroom had a bed, a wardrobe, a desk and some posters on the wall. The house had an unusual feature: the toilet was outside, in the garden.

questions.q: What type of house was it?

questions.a: A living room and a kitchen
options: A living room and a kitchen

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: My holiday home is a caravan near a lake. It is small, but it has everything we need. There are two bedrooms, a tiny kitchen and a sitting area. In the kitchen, there is a fridge, a cooker and a sink. There is also a shower, but there isn't a bath. Outside, there are two chairs and a small table.

questions.a: Two chairs and a small table
options: Two chairs and a small table

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: The Equator divides Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere. The world has large continents and oceans. Countries can have natural borders such as rivers and mountain ranges. The planet also has different time zones, so two cities can have very different local times at the same moment. Compass points such as north, south, east and west help us describe location.

questions.q: What divides Earth into two hemispheres?
What can be a natural border?
questions.a: A river or a mountain range
options: A river or a mountain range

questions.q: Why can two cities have different local times?
questions.a: They are in different time zones
options: They are in different time zones

questions.q: What do compass points help describe?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Buckingham Palace is a famous royal building in London. It is very large and has hundreds of rooms. There are many bedrooms and bathrooms, and there is also a café for visitors. Some areas are open to tourists at certain times of the year. The building is famous around the world.

questions.q: Is there a café for visitors?
